Gift cards open once the store is connected to Stripe.

Meanwhile, any title can be sent as a gift from the cart.

How it works
  1. Choose an amount and pay with Stripe.
  2. The recipient gets a code by e-mail (or you do).
  3. They enter it in the promotion-code box at checkout.
Good to know

Codes are single use and never expire. Any unused balance is not carried forward, so a cart worth at least the code's value makes the most of it. No cash value. Terms.
